_comment: Every value carries provenance. 'observed' = recovered exactly from the demo recording; 'assumed' = not shown in the demo, chosen so the flow is complete. Change assumed values freely; the client's real business rules replace this file.

gold.fine_weight_formula_provenance: observed: certificate note 'Fine Weight = Net x (K/22)'; 91.48 g @ 20K -> 83.1636 g
gold.ltv_provenance: observed: max eligible 399,185.46 = 80% of 498,981.82 (a flat 80% in the demo). That loan sits in the 2.5-5 lakh slab of the RBI gold-loan directions effective 1 Apr 2026 (85% up to 2.5 lakh, 80% up to 5 lakh, 75% above), so the tiers are used; the demo's number is reproduced exactly. Where a higher-LTV slab would overshoot its cap the loan plateaus at the cap.
gold.weight_match_tolerance_provenance: assumed: scale reading vs certificate gross weight

schemes_provenance: observed: the three offers shown in the demo (processing_fee_pct 1 seen on GL_FULL_BULLET_12, applied to all)
emi_formula: reducing balance at roi/12 over tenure_months (Bullet: interest-only monthly, principal at maturity)
emi_provenance: observed for EMI: 399,185.46 @ 11% x 12m = 35,280.67. Bullet formula assumed.

roi_negotiation.provenance: assumed: demo narration says the customer 'can negotiate the ROI' but no negotiation was shown

income.income_required_provenance: observed: INCOME_REQUIRED error 'Loan above Rs 250,000 requires income capture'
income.foir_provenance: observed as ABSENT: demo EMI 35,280 vs avg net pay 48,900 (72%) still passed. Flip on to generate FOIR-rejection scenarios (threshold assumed)
income.self_employed_provenance: assumed: not shown; routed to branch / manual underwriting

bureau.provenance: observed: 742 -> 'Good'. Other tier boundaries and the 650 floor are assumed

closing.cooling_off_provenance: observed (narration): 60-second waiting period before approval check
closing.note: The agent only soft-allocates: real money movement is done by the client's payment gateway (demo correction at 14:44). allocate_and_disburse therefore records a mock transaction.
